title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Foresce Castle (Cheerleader Section)
description:
One of the interior backgrounds from Foresce Castle, of Ganbare Goemon 4. This section has an audience which shout words that can damage the player, and annoying cheerleader robots. Great for mechanical levels, overall. Or maybe a stadium?

Credit would be great, but is optional.
